name: native-handlers
description: From the Damocles title screen, press Space once, wait for world load, capture, then disassemble the live 68000 code from $054700 through $0556FF. This window covers the three native routines the Damocles Script interpreter reaches from its dispatch loop and handlers, left Unresolved by #128 and asked for by #136: $054764 (bsr from $05194C when $7A88 is non-zero), $0547C6 (branch target from $051944 when $7B96 is non-zero), and $054848 (bsr from the key/case handler $0B at $051A7E and from the BCD handler $0E at $051AE6 on the $00F8 special case). The window starts below $054764 and runs far enough past $054848 to contain the routine bodies rather than only their entries. Working-Authority Evidence for #136; relates to #81, #85. Hatari stops consuming FIFO commands after a listing, so the disassembly is the single last action, after the capture. The listing is untracked Restricted Material; only decoded facts enter research notes.
